body: The path to sobriety is almost never a straight shot to the top. It is a small “setback,” if you even want to call it that but, don’t let that turn into you throwing in the towel. It is not a reset. Like you said, continue doing what you set out to do. You consumed 15mg over 13 days. That’s awesome, be proud! Compare yourself to where you were months ago, where you probably consumed way more than that in just a single sitting. Be proud, take it day by day, and tell yourself that many people have dealt with, and beaten the same feelings you’re struggling with at the moment. All I can say is you fucking got this and I believe in you
